name: Farid, Enterprising Salvager
oracle_text:
Whenever a nontoken artifact you control is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, create a colorless artifact token named Scrap.
{1}{R}, Sacrifice an artifact: Choose one —
• Put a +1/+1 counter on Farid. It gains menace until end of turn.
• Goad target creature.
• Discard a card, then draw a card.
blocked_sentences: Whenever a nontoken artifact you control is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, create a colorless artifact token named Scrap.

needs.what: a colorless artifact token named Scrap with no abilities and no subtypes (token id e.g. scrap_token)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: token_ids has no Scrap; the nearest colorless noncreature artifact tokens (treasure_token, clue_token, junk_token, replicated_ring_token) all carry abilities or a subtype, so substituting one would give Farid a different token. The trigger itself (put_into_graveyard from battlefield, filter types Artifact, is_token false, controller you) and the modal sacrifice ability (sacrifice cost, choose_mode with add_counters+grant_keyword menace, goad, discard then draw) are expressible
